<b>Scabflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are sticky young [[Slab Penitents#The Jailers|jailer]] flies, born and grown in service to [[the Slab]].<ref>Scabfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Sticky young fly, born and grown in service to the Slab."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Scabflies sit on [[Penitent]]s while idle. Once disturbed, they start to fly around in diagonal lines, bouncing off walls. 

Scabflies do not target [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], but still deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Scabflies have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Sinner!...
* Born in filth...
* No escape!
* Be still! Be still!
* No light!
}}

== Location ==
Scabflies can be found in [[the Slab]]. Six are encountered as part of the eastern [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Slab 1|enemy gauntlet]], and another six appear during the northwestern [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Slab 2|gauntlet]] (or four, if Hornet triggers the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Slab 3|alternative variation]] by reaching the arena via the [[Choral Chambers]] entrance instead of being [[The Slab#Capture by Wardenfly|captured]]).

Outside the gauntlets, Scabflies spawn exclusively perched on [[Penitent]]s. One of these Penitents is already dead, but the other is alive and can be killed, which prevents its Scabfly from respawning until Hornet rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]].
